evals.name: forecast-agi-timeline
evals.prompt: forecast: will AGI become reality within the next 1-2 years? I lead an internal AI strategy group and need your best call, how confident you are, and what to watch.
evals.expected_output: A forecast brief: the question made resolvable with a named definition and deadline, reference class/base rate, decomposition, tagged and dated signals, likelihood word + numeric range and a separate confidence level, scenarios, dated signposts including one that breaks the thesis, unknowns, linked sources.

evals.name: contested-claim-ai-hiring
evals.prompt: brief me on: is the narrative that AI coding agents are replacing junior software developers actually supported by hiring data, or is it ahead of the evidence?
evals.expected_output: A targeted brief: bottom line first, tagged/dated evidence with independence and lineage checked, an explicit counter-evidence search result, rival explanations, unknowns, what would change the conclusion, sources.

evals.name: quick-status-upper-cband
evals.prompt: quick: what's the current status of the FCC upper C-band auction (3.98-4.2 GHz) — auction date and band plan?
evals.expected_output: A short answer (under ~150 words) with the date, band plan, one qualification and a dated primary source; no padding, few searches.
